fusions.name: Smothering Billow
fusions.desc: Billows your wings over a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 10 damage to everything in it and stunning it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Unpicking Peck
fusions.desc: Darts a quill at a target carrying one of your afflictions for 8 damage, using that affliction up.

fusions.name: Woven Nest
fusions.desc: Weaves a nest 3 tiles around where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Tucked Under the Wing
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina runs out, a shield worth 15% of your maximum health closes over you for 4 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
